name: Tank Level Control with Hysteresis
description: Fill pump controlled by level switches with hysteresis. High level stops fill, low level starts fill. Overflow alarm on high-high.
safety_notes: High_Level must immediately stop Fill_Pump regardless of other conditions. Overflow alarm fires if High_Level is reached while pump is still on.
common_mistakes: Not checking Fault_State before enabling pump
Missing overflow alarm for high-high condition
